messages:
Sam: quick thought — intake feels clogged with validators wired in three places. proposing a small DI/refactor so the intake pipeline composes validator adapters instead of copying logic across bench/runtime/ingest.
Yuki: short + sweet. what would the adapter contract look like?
Sam: something like: `validate(model_meta, artifact_uri) -> {ok: bool, errors: [str], stats: {latency_ms, token_mismatch}}`. pluggable impls can return extra `hints` for runtime.
Marco: can we keep bench-runner fast? adding indirection worries me for hot paths.
Sam: agreed — plan is zero-cost at runtime when using compiled/native impls. adapters are only used during onboarding/benching phases (not token-generation hot loop).
Dana: we should also version the contract. breaking changes = pain. propose `validator_v1` with stable fields and a shim layer.
Lee: +1 for versioning. also want a canonical small shim that converts legacy validator outputs to v1. keeps rollout simple.
Yuki: tradeoffs: single contract helps tooling, but may limit expressive checks (e.g., per-model golden diffs). can we allow an `extensions` map for noncritical results?
Sam: exactly — core fields required, `extensions` freeform. runtime will only rely on core. bench/analytics can parse extensions.
Marco: how do we run contract tests? I suggest a tiny harness repo that runs a set of golden artifacts through any validator impl and checks conformance and metrics.
Dana: +1. add CI gate: any validator PR must include a small matrix run against canonical artifacts (fast subset). mark large runs optional.
ci-bot: note: we can add a GitHub Action that downloads 3 small artifacts and runs `validator-contract-check` binary — should be <5m.
Lee: ops question — where do we store validator metadata (version, declared capabilities like `needs-onnx`, `quantized-ok`)?
Sam: put a lightweight YAML next to the adapter in model-registry metadata: `validator: { impl: "foo", version: "v1", capabilities: ["kv-check","shape"] }`. runtime ignores it, onboarding reads it.
Yuki: how to handle fallback when validator is missing? silent allow, but flag in intake UI and default to conservative SLA?
Dana: require a minimal smoke validator for all models; if missing the intake marks `needs_review`. long term we can auto-suggest validators from similar models.
Marco: rollout plan: phase 1: DI layer + v1 contract + shim for legacy validators. phase 2: CI harness + repo + action. phase 3: UI flags and auto-suggest.
Sam: action items: 1) I’ll open RFC PR with contract sketch + shim strategy, 2) @Yuki to prototype `validator-contract-check` CLI, 3) @Dana to list canonical small artifacts for CI.
Lee: thumbs up. add doc snippet for sample contract in RFC.
Sam: here is a tiny example to paste in RFC:
```
# validator_v1 output (yaml)
status: ok
errors: []
stats:
  validation_ms: 312
  token_mismatch: 0
extensions:
  fuzzy_score: 0.82
```
Sam: will post RFC link when ready. thanks all :thumbsup:
__notes: thread focuses on dependency-injection refactor for intake validators, contract versioning, CI harness, and rollout phases. conversational, short messages with actions.
